messages.subject: Sutherland Logistics v Vantage Freight - disclosure deadline
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Sarah,

In the Vantage Freight matter (claim no. CC-2025-LON-000389), we note extended disclosure is due by 26 June. Our client will be serving its disclosure report and we'd suggest a call next week to agree the disclosure review protocol and the list of issues. This is unrelated to your client's other commercial work but I copy Tom Gallagher who I understand has conduct.

Kind regards,
Martin Greaves
Marlowe Greaves LLP
